# sigma_tag (Resource)

A Sigma version tag definition. Tags are applied to specific workbook/report versions via the Sigma API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A version-tag definition, applied to workbook/report versions via the
# Sigma API. Color is one of the names from Sigma's tag UI palette
# (e.g. red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, violet, pink, gray).
resource "sigma_tag" "release" {
  name        = "release"
  color       = "violet"
  description = "Production-ready snapshots."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tag name. Must be unique. Immutable after create.

### Optional

- `color` (String) One of `cyan`, `grass`, `violet`, `plum`, `amber`, `bronze`. Defaults to `cyan` if not set (the Sigma API rejects creates without a color). Immutable after create.
- `description` (String) Tag description. The only mutable attribute.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `owner_id` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_tag.example '<version_tag_id>'
```
